name: r3-xsplit
levers: G02 (attn:L-XS) XSPLIT: fused one-launch split-tile sparse MLA decode for the DSV4 dual-cache call (prefill_mg_dual path) with exact in-order look-back

flags.name: DSV41_ATTN_XSPLIT
flags.meaning: Route in-envelope PREFILL_MG_DUAL calls (DSV4, 8 heads, 1 <= T <= 64, main PBS 64, extra PBS 64/32, runtime lengths present, T*max_tiles <= cap) to dsv41_xsplit_mg_dual_kernel<PBSX> in libdsv41_xsplit.so. Read once at import of flashinfer/mla/_sparse_mla_sm120.py; unset/0 = the live code path, untouched kernel, same graphs.

flags.name: DSV41_ATTN_XSPLIT_CHECK
flags.meaning: Bitwise self-check of the first eager call of every shape against the live kernel on the live inputs; a shape is never routed inside a CUDA-graph capture before it passed. Never 0 in serving.

flags.name: DSV41_ATTN_XSPLIT_ON_MISMATCH
flags.meaning: raise = fail closed (RuntimeError before serving anything); disable = keep the live result and turn XSPLIT off for the process.

flags.name: DSV41_ATTN_XSPLIT_GRID
flags.meaning: Persistent grid cap (46 = 48 SMs minus the 2 the WOA l2pf co-runner holds). Exact for any value (dynamic in-order claiming).

flags.name: DSV41_ATTN_XSPLIT_CAP_UNITS
flags.meaning: Workspace capacity in tile-rows (64 tokens x 18 tiles); calls with T*max_tiles above it run the live kernel. 25,472 B per tile-row (29.3 MiB per slot at 1152).

flags.name: DSV41_ATTN_XSPLIT_NWS
flags.meaning: Workspace slots allocated once at the first eager routed call (one per calling stream: eager stream + capture stream).

flags.name: DSV41_ATTN_XSPLIT_MAX_T
flags.meaning: Planner gate on num_tokens (decode/verify only; prefill keeps the live kernel).

flags.name: DSV41_ATTN_XSPLIT_LIB
flags.meaning: Location of libdsv41_xsplit.so and its .sha256 sidecar (sha checked at load).
